behavior.label: Select behavior
behavior.helpText: "Report" will flag content for review without removing it. "Filter" will remove content and send it for review. "Remove" will remove content without sending it for review.

actionPosts.label: Action posts
actionPosts.helpText: If enabled, the app will action posts from users with a note on their account.

actionComments.label: Action comments
actionComments.helpText: If enabled, the app will action comments from users with a note on their account.

actionSpamWatch.label: Action users with a "Spam Watch" note
actionSpamWatch.helpText: If enabled, the app will action content from users with a "Spam Watch" note on their account.

actionSpamWarning.label: Action users with a "Spam Warning" note
actionSpamWarning.helpText: If enabled, the app will action content from users with a a "Spam Warning" note on their account.

actionAbuseWarning.label: Action users with an "Abuse Warning" note
actionAbuseWarning.helpText: If enabled, the app will action content from users with an "Abuse Warning" note on their account.

actionBanNote.label: Action users with a "Ban" note
actionBanNote.helpText: If enabled, the app will action content from users with a "Ban" note on their account (typically from a previous ban).

actionNoLabel.label: Action users with a standard note
actionNoLabel.helpText: If enabled, the app will action content from users who have a note on their account without a specific label.

exemptApproved.label: Exempt approved users
exemptApproved.helpText: If enabled, the app will not action content from users who have been approved by mods.
